limitations: Tyre compounds come from the OpenF1 stint feed, matched to these pit-stop-derived stints by driver code and lap overlap. A stint that could not be matched confidently is left uncoloured rather than guessed.
Degradation slopes are not fuel-corrected; within one stint fuel burn and tyre degradation are not separately identifiable from lap times.
No track-status channel, so safety-car and traffic laps are excluded by an outlier rule rather than by flag.

Undercut figures measure what happened to the gap, not what would have happened otherwise; a driver can gain on a rival for reasons unrelated to the stop. Entries whose window looks neutralised are flagged, not dropped.
